paragraphs: R' Simlai. In Zohar, Aharei Mot, at עקל״ה [provisionally 135; edition, page and side uncollated]: R' Abba and R' Yose saw a mark on someone's face. R' Abba said that he had sinned through sexual immorality, and so it was. The man said that R' Simlai had prescribed repentance for him.
